name: 星鲸谷物语
description: Starwhale Valley — a pixel-art living wallpaper: the farm follows the clock, the seasons and the real weather, a little whale girl lives inside it, and the whole soundscape — ambience and a looping tune — is generated from scratch.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 星鲸谷物语 Starwhale Valley——像素风动态壁纸，农场随昼夜、季节与真实天气变幻，里面还住着一只小鲸鱼，风声雨声脚步和背景音乐都是算出来的。
